name: ATP Tour
notes: Calendar-year competition; season field uses bare 2026. The 2026 ATP Tour runs January to November with the Next Gen ATP Finals in December.

PIF is the first-ever naming partner of the ATP Rankings ('PIF ATP Rankings') and a Platinum Partner of the ATP Tour; PIF's partner page at bnpparibasopen.com/partners/pif describes it as 'exclusive naming partner of both the ATP and WTA Rankings' and 'Platinum Partner of the ATP Tour' (fetched 25 Sep 2026).
Nitto extended as title sponsor of the ATP Finals in Turin through 2030; the 2026 edition is the 2026 Nitto ATP Finals (15-22 Nov 2026, Inalpi Arena).
Tour/competition sponsors are recorded as clubId-null deals; the events themselves are not club records.
